# Longbridge Technical Analysis

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. Chart patterns describe how prices behaved, not how they will behave, and every school in this skill can produce losing signals. Curated by Skill Harbor: the technical analysis skill of the Longbridge platform, published by the broker itself. It bundles nine frameworks over OHLCV data fetched through the Longbridge CLI: recognition of 15 classic candlestick patterns with trend confirmation; the Ichimoku cloud five-line system; a technical indicator set (EMA, ADX, Bollinger Bands, RSI, OBV, volume ratio) combined into a three-dimension vote; harmonic XABCD patterns (Gartley, Bat, Butterfly, Crab) built on Fibonacci geometry; Elliott Wave counting in two variants, including an institutional timing version with momentum confirmation; Chan Theory with automatic fractal, bi and zhongshu detection and its first, second and third buy points; Smart Money Concepts (break of structure, change of character, fair value gaps, order blocks); and Turtle Trading System 1 and System 2 breakouts with ATR-based unit position sizing, stop-loss and add-on levels. Every framework starts by fetching K-line history, and none of it needs an account login. From the longbridge/skills repository (MIT). Honest caveats: two frameworks need extra Python packages (czsc for Chan Theory, smartmoneyconcepts for SMC), and interpretive schools such as Elliott Wave and Chan Theory depend heavily on parameters and analyst...
